info.name: papi Account Info Manage POIs API

items.docs:
The Get Custom POI Info service can be used to retrieve information regarding any of your <<glossary:Custom POI>>s, by providing its id.</br> If the requested Custom POI is newly created, this endpoint will respond with the following statuses:</br>
- **HTTP code = 200**: The full response for the Get Custom POI is provided.</br> - **HTTP code = 202**: The creation process is still in progress.</br> - **HTTP code = 404**: The POI does not exist, indicating a failure in the creation process. Pleas

items.docs: This service can be used to detach entities from an existing tag.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude of query location, if specified then response will not include <<glossary:Chains>>

params.name: lng
params.description: Longitude of query location, if specified then response will not include chains

params.name: query
params.description: String included in the entity name

params.name: radius
params.description: Filter results by radius in miles. default value 0.01 miles

params.name: groupCategory
params.description: Filter specific group category i.e. Search POIs by business domains (e.g. Apparel,Dining, ....)

params.name: entityType
params.description: Filter out specific entity type in search result. If this is not provided, all entity types will be returned

params.name: includeFlaggedEntities
params.description: If the parameter is set to true, the response will also include flagged entities

items.docs:
This service returns a list of Placer managed entities in a particular area. You can search based on any combination of the following filter parameters:
entities within a specific location radius, entities associated with a specific group category/category/sub category, entity name or type.
The response lists the matched entities, including address and location, zip code, group category, category ,sub-category and a link to Placer dashboard.
